en: Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing two ornate Catholic banners crossed above a small church complex. The left banner reads "Katholisches Casino Radeberg 1884 1906" framed by laurel leaves. The right banner bears an image of Saint Joseph holding the Christ Child, surrounded by decorative foliage and scrollwork. Below, a vignette depicts a neo‑Gothic Catholic church with an adjoining parsonage and school; a small sign in front labels them. Grapevines and a tree frame the composition.
